title: Tariff Act of 1930
source_id: 19 U.S.C. 1202 et seq. (ch. 4); short title at 19 U.S.C. 1654
verified_how: Fetched govinfo USCODE-2024 19 U.S.C. 1654, headed 'Short title'. The text reads 'This chapter may be cited as the "Tariff Act of 1930"'.
notes: Covers customs administration, valuation, entry, drawback and antidumping/countervailing duties. The duty rates themselves are in the Harmonized Tariff Schedule, maintained under 19 U.S.C. 3004 (Omnibus Trade and Competitiveness Act of 1988), and are often changed by presidential proclamation under trade statutes.
